name: little-zelensky-simulator
description: A single-player, presidential-perspective crisis decision simulator of the 2022 Battle of Kyiv (Feb 24 - Apr 2), with a classic seven-day opening mode, condition-driven campaign events, multiple storylines that differ per playthrough, a post-completion decision replay room, a per-window presidential workbench, a post-campaign history archive, and a v1.3 war-archive visual system (strategic situation map, campaign timeline, storyline rail, document typography).
